_note: Keyless hosted LLM endpoints for LLM_PROVIDER=free. These services permit truly anonymous, no-API-key access — so LocalMind never asks the user for a key. Pick one with LLM_FREE_ENDPOINT, a model with LLM_FREE_MODEL (override the whole endpoint with LLM_FREE_BASE_URL when you know a compatible one). There is no fallback or auto-switching: LocalMind calls exactly the endpoint the user chose. Free endpoints change policies and can be rate-limited; treat them as experimental.
